handoff.salientSummary: Implemented Job creator for evaluation execution in k8s-integration milestone. Created internal/k8s/job package with CreateJob function that generates Kubernetes Jobs with ConfigMap and Secret volumes, resource limits (500m CPU, 512Mi memory), RestartPolicy=OnFailure, backoffLimit=3, and activeDeadlineSeconds=7200.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created Job creator package (internal/k8s/job/creator.go) with CreateJob function that creates Kubernetes Jobs with: namespace from parameter, labels (app=llm-eval, eval-id, model, dataset), container image from spec/config, resource limits (500m CPU request/limit, 512Mi memory request/limit), ConfigMap volume mount at /etc/config, Secret volume mount at /etc/api-keys, RestartPolicy=OnFailure, BackoffLimit=3, ActiveDeadlineSeconds=7200. Also created comprehensive test suite (creator_test.go) with 22 test cases covering all validation contract assertions.
